title: oa_ad_clids cookie / localStorage value
description: JSON {<key>: {v, ts}} written by the Astro shim (gclid, gbraid, wbraid, fbclid, msclkid, ttclid) and the Suite (gclid, fbclid, msclkid, ttclid); cookie Max-Age=7776000, Path=/, Domain=.openart.ai, SameSite=Lax, Secure. The Suite reader keeps only its 4 keys and rewrites the value, which deletes a stored gbraid/wbraid (research/01 T2c, research/02 §3.3). ts = Date.now() in ms.
